verdict.rationale: LightSprint lets teammates hop into a live, shareable browser preview of an in-progress task to watch it build and weigh in. That is a light form of browser-based redirection. It also supports local and remote coding via Claude or Codex, with PRs and ticket state tracked, and lets users ship polish fixes themselves. Nothing documents an explicit handoff that moves an in-progress cloud agent session into a developer's editor or terminal. Missing for 10: documented takeover of a running agent task into a local editor or terminal, explicit pause/redirect controls for an active agent, and hands-on corroboration.
